aboutIntro.name: Edrick Sinsuan
aboutIntro.title: Mainframe Computer Operator and Open-Source Software Developer
aboutIntro.overview: A full-time mainframe computer operator studying computer engineering at Florida State University. Highly adaptive with technologies, capable of working with or without a team under pressure and experienced with programming and troubleshooting various computer systems and software.

workExperience.title: Computer Operator III
description: Department of Financial Services, Tallahassee, FL, USA
responsibilities: Establishes, modifies, and controls production activities for mainframe applications:
Setup, verify, and monitor the processing of production jobs.
Determine the cause of abnormal termination of jobs and take appropriate action according to instructions.
Review on-line production activity logs daily, to maintain awareness of production status and problems.
Assists with scheduling and maintaining production jobs and application related functions as instructed through Production Control Action Requests (PCAR).

Maintains knowledge of JCL (Job Control Language) and software packages required for job performance using the on-line operations guide, personal notes and documentation, manuals, and formal and informal training.
Assisted the Production Control supervisors in setting up SharePoint leave calendar notifications.

workExperience.title: Computer Systems Analyst
description: The Florida Lottery, Tallahassee, FL, USA
responsibilities: Performed Computer Systems Operator roles as needed.
Performed Production Control analysts' tasks such as scheduling jobs, releasing jobs, releasing streams, etc.
Assisted in the creating, updating, and reviewing of all Computer Systems Operations standard operating procedures (SOPs) and backup and recovery procedures and processes.
Assisted the Tallahassee and Orlando Data Center Supervisor in supervising both data centers.
Helped trained new Computer System Operators in accordance with standard operating procedures and training checklist provided by the Computer Systems Operation Manager.

Improved and cleaned up Power Automate flows to reduce failures and steps required to generate required daily OPERLOG and properly routinely archive OPERLOGs from previous days of which are accessed through SharePoint.
Wrote implemented startup Windows batch scripts to clean up unnecessary files and prevent the Operators' computers from running out of disk space.

workExperience.title: Computer Systems Operator
description: The Florida Lottery, Tallahassee, FL, USA
responsibilities: Operated all components of the Lottery's computer systems. This includes timely completion of monitored jobs and processing daily draws for games that occur during specific shift time frames. Helped plan workloads, workflows, and priorities for job scheduling. Make corrections necessary to complete work on schedule.
Handled emergency situations (computer hardware failures, software problems, inclement weather, etc.) through approved emergency guidelines.

Followed approved agency procedures to balance reports generated by the daily draws, the ICS Systems, and the Vendor's reports. Handled draw discrepancies according to approved emergency procedures. Also resolved any balancing issues as per standard operating procedures.

Provided necessary assistance to the Computer Systems Operation Manager, the Orlando Data Center Shift Supervisor, and the COOP Coordinator in the development, implementation, and testing of the Lottery's Information Technology Disaster Recovery Plan (ITDRP) and Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP).
Monitored environment and electrical power to maintain narrow margin of operating conditions necessary to keep computer systems functioning.
Maintained operating records on production and performance reports. Documented daily actions in online operator log (OPERLOG) for review daily by Operations personnel.
